description: Manage account webhooks: HTTPS endpoints that receive signed events such as job.completed, batch.completed, monitor.changed, credits.low and run.* events. action=create needs url (events defaults to job.completed); the response carries the signing secret once, so store it. list returns your webhooks; get, update (replaces the fields you send), delete, test (sends a sample event_type) and deliveries (recent delivery attempts) take webhook_id. Secret rotation stays in the dashboard and REST API. Use webhook_url on a single request instead when you only need one callback. Cloud export, extraction templates, org and API key management, BYOK and workflow definitions have no MCP tool: they are dashboard/API only.

action.description: create, list, get, update, delete, test or deliveries

event_type.description: test: event type of the sample payload. Default job.completed

events.description: create, update: event types to subscribe to, e.g. ['job.completed', 'monitor.changed']. Default ['job.completed']

include_inactive.description: list: include disabled webhooks. Default false

is_active.description: update: enable or disable the webhook

name.description: create, update: webhook name. Default 'My Webhook'

url.description: create, update: HTTPS endpoint that receives events

webhook_id.description: get, update, delete, test, deliveries: webhook ID

name: alterlab_webhook
title: Account Webhooks
